title: Myth vs Fact: Chemical Drain Cleaners
description: Many homeowners reach for chemical drain cleaners at the first sign of a clog, believing they offer a quick fix. However, strong chemical solutions often fail to clear heavy obstructions like grease or hair mats and can generate high heat, damaging PVC pipes or corroding older metal lines. Furthermore, standing chemical water poses severe chemical burn hazards to plumbers who must later clear the drain manually. Professional drain cleaning relies on mechanical augers or hydro-jetting to safely and completely clear line blockages without compromising pipe integrity or personal safety.

Myth vs Fact: Chemical Drain Cleaners

Many homeowners reach for chemical drain cleaners at the first sign of a clog, believing they offer a quick fix. However, strong chemical solutions often fail to clear heavy obstructions like grease or hair mats and can generate high heat, damaging PVC pipes or corroding older metal lines. Furthermore, standing chemical water poses severe chemical burn hazards to plumbers who must later clear the drain manually. Professional drain cleaning relies on mechanical augers or hydro-jetting to safely and completely clear line blockages without compromising pipe integrity or personal safety.
